name: Hald CLUT
description: Recolours the first input through a 3D lookup table given as a Hald CLUT picture on the second input.

inputs.name: clut
inputs.description: Hald CLUT picture: a square of level^3 pixels a side (for example 512x512 for level 8)

params.name: interp
params.description: Interpolation between the entries of the table
